name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: D.C. Reflecting Pool saga continues as Trump slams Pirro for saying contractors caused damage
changes.summary: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool is now drained of water and awaiting repairs, as a feud within the Trump administration spills into the open. President Trump and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum are both rejecting the conclusion by U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro that contractors caused the pool to peel. Olivia Rinaldi.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s confirmation as attorney general has been held up over concerns about a planned $1.8 billion fund for Trump allies and the president’s immunity from tax scrutiny.

changes.title: Iran denies Trump claim that new talks will start Monday after he called off attacks
changes.summary: The United States and Iran will hold new talks Monday afternoon, President Donald Trump said, after announcing he called off intense new strikes to allow for a deal on the Strait of Hormuz and Tehran’s nuclear program.

changes.title: Todd Blanche reaches deal with GOP holdouts and Ariana Grande steps back: Morning Rundown
changes.summary: Trump’s attorney general pick scraps an “anti-weaponization” fund in a deal with holdout senators.

changes.title: For Republicans planning post-Trump future, one race in Washington is worth watching
changes.summary: The primary to replace Rep. Dan Newhouse is a rare opportunity for Washington's Republicans to seek federal office. Candidates representing different wings of the party are testing Trump's influence. (Image credit: Sarah Silbiger/Getty Images).

changes.title: Trump and Senate GOP deadlocked on key issues as congressional recess approaches
changes.summary: With a long congressional recess set to begin at the end of the week, Senate Republicans have a lot they want to accomplish. But they're deadlocked with President Trump on several key GOP priorities.

changes.title: Political strategist weighs in on the tension between Trump and Senate Republicans
changes.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with political strategist Alex Conant about the tensions between the Senate and President Trump ahead of the long congressional recess that starts later this week.

changes.title: Michigan’s GOP governor primary is getting weird
changes.summary: Michigan Republicans haven’t had a better shot to win the governorship in over a decade. Deciding who should take it is turning into an ugly, hyper-online brawl. With widespread name recognition and an endorsement from President Donald Trump, Rep. John James appears poised to be the GOP nominee ahead of Michigan’s prim.
